Katie Puckrik Presents A Yacht Rock Odyssey" is a rock compilation album released in 2024 by Demon Records. This 2LP set showcases the smooth, melodic style characteristic of yacht rock, a genre blending soft rock, pop, and R&B elements popular in the late 1970s and early 1980s. Curated by Katie Puckrik, the album offers a curated journey through the genre's signature laid-back grooves and polished production, capturing the essence of the yacht rock sound.

As a various artists compilation, the album does not belong to a single artist's discography but serves as a thematic collection highlighting the genre's defining tracks and artists. Released originally in 2024, it has been issued on heavyweight 140-gram vinyl, emphasizing its appeal to collectors and enthusiasts of classic rock and soft rock styles. While specific critical or commercial reception details are limited, the album's release by Demon Records, known for quality reissues and compilations, positions it as a respected anthology within the yacht rock niche.
